title: Build a list with a rule
summary: Julia: Build a list with a rule. Use n > 1 instead.
introduction: A comprehension makes values from inputs and an optional filter.
learningObjectives: Build a list with a rule with Julia

blocks.text: Install Julia. Save each example as lesson.jl and run julia lesson.jl, or paste it into the Julia REPL.
Build a list with a rule

blocks.title: Build a list with a rule
blocks.code: println([n * 2 for n in 1:4 if n > 2])

blocks.text: The filter keeps 3 and 4, then the result expression doubles them.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Read the filter before working out which values are included.
